title: ci(ui-merge): nine objectui correctness gates the #25697 roster kept have run nowhere since the nested workflows were deleted; port the four that guard published @object-ui packages (parent #25677)
body:
Filing gate ④ (承父单: a follow-up owed by landed work, the #25697 workflow roster, under epic #25677) + ①-adjacent: a gate population with a named landing point that has run nowhere since `ui/.github/workflows/**` was deleted (#26058, 2026-10-26). Part of #25677. ⛔ Not a claim. Touches `.github/workflows/ci.yml` = Tier H: GOVERNED_APPROVERS review, the PR stops at draft.

## 维护者速读

objectui 并入前,有 9 个"正确性"检查在 objectui 自己的 CI 里跑。合并时的清单(#25697 评论 6388182608)把它们标为"保留、稍后移植",#26058 删掉 objectui 的 workflow 时也写了"移植时从本 PR 父提交读取"。但之后没有卡接手,根 CI 至今没跑其中任何一个(覆盖率已移到 `ui-coverage-nightly.yml`,不在此列)。最要紧的是 `check-published-dist-tooling`:objectui 每次发 `@object-ui/*` 之前都跑它(`ui/package.json` 的 `changeset:publish`),防止把测试文件或 `vitest` 导入打进 npm 包;根仓的发布脚本 `scripts/release-publish.sh` 不跑它,所以 18.2 发布时没有经过这道检查。建议:移植四个保护已发布包的检查,其余五个按下表退役或改为报告。

## 谁付代价(业务筛)

Anyone who installs `@object-ui/*` from npm. These gates exist because the defects reached consumers before:
- objectui#4836 measured `dist/__benchmarks__/core.bench.js` in a published package, a module whose first statement imports `vitest`, which no consumer installs (`check-published-dist-tooling.mjs` header).
- objectui#4538: `packages/react/dist/index.js` re-exported through extensionless relative specifiers that Node's resolver cannot load (`check-node-esm-load.mjs` header). Only the specifier leg runs today (`type-check-ui`, `pnpm --dir ui run check:esm-specifiers`); the load leg, which evaluates each built entry, runs nowhere.
- `performance-budget.yml` enforced the Console's eager-closure budget (`check:eager-closure`); a Console first-load regression now lands unmeasured.

Cost of not doing it: the next `@object-ui/*` publish ships whatever these gates would have refused, and a consumer finds it.

## Measured (origin/main 437310316, 2026-10-27)

`git grep` over `.github/workflows/` finds none of these aliases or scripts. Roster rows are #25697 comment 6388182608; the deleted workflow files are readable at #26058's parent.

| Row | objectui workflow / job | What it guarded | Proposed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 23 | `published-dist-gate.yml` (`check:published-dist`) | tooling files in published `dist/` | **port**, and run it before publish in `scripts/release-publish.sh` too (it was in objectui's `changeset:publish`) |
| 21 | `node-esm-load-gate.yml` (`check:node-esm-load`, full leg) | every published ESM entry loads in Node | **port** (push/schedule as before, it costs a build) |
| 7 | `ci.yml` "Test (dist pins)" (`test:dist` on `@object-ui/components`) | assertions on built dist | **port** into `Build & E2E UI`, which already builds |
| 22 | `performance-budget.yml` (`check:eager-closure`) | Console eager-closure budget | **port**, folded into `Build & E2E UI` (the roster's note: avoid a second Console build) |
| 19 | `lockfile-integrity.yml` | a lockfile change may not silently duplicate a dependency | port or retire: the seat measures overlap with root `validate-deps.yml` first |
| 18 | `lockfile-dedupe.yml` | report-only wrapper around `pnpm dedupe --check` | retire, or one `continue-on-error` step, per #25920's measurement (145 runs / 90 days, 0 failures) |
| 7 | `ci.yml` "Build Docs" (`@object-ui/site`) | the objectui docs site builds | decide with F14 / docs-deploy (sub-issue 4 row 10) |
| 17 | `live-e2e.yml` (informational) | live backend E2E | retire unless a seat owns reading it |
| 26 | `shadcn-check.yml` (schedule report) | upstream shadcn updates | retire (a maintenance report, never a gate) |

## Who acts

A `domain:devx` card thread, editing `ci.yml` (`build-e2e-ui` region plus one push/schedule job) and `scripts/release-publish.sh`. The rows marked "retire" need no code beyond deleting their `ui/package.json` aliases and scripts if nothing else reads them (check `ui/scripts/__tests__` first). Any new required context is the maintainer's, not this card's.

## Acceptance

- Each ported gate runs in the root CI with its `<check> — <step>` name, and one run id per gate is on the card.
- A counter-probe per ported gate: a deliberate defect (a `*.test.d.ts` copied into a built `dist/`, an extensionless relative re-export) turns its step red, then is reverted.
- `scripts/release-publish.sh` refuses to publish when `check-published-dist-tooling` exits non-zero.
- The retired rows are listed on the card with what replaced them, or "nothing, by choice".

**Duplicate search.** objectstack-ai/objectstack, "port objectui correctness gates lockfile dedupe node esm load published dist performance budget into root CI": 10 hits. #25880 (closed) ported the 19 repo gates and left these rows out by name ("each stays its roster row"); #25920 (closed) measured the dedupe wrapper; #25697 and #25678 (open, closing). No card carries the ports. **New.**

**Size:** M. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.
